implementation_notes: The BCL owns the atomicity: a static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TInstance> plus GetOrAdd(key, k => new TInstance(k)) returns the existing value or inserts and returns the new one (fine-grained locking for writes, lock-free reads). Keep the constructor private so the accessor stays the only way in, and remember GetOrAdd's valueFactory runs outside the lock and may therefore run more than once when threads race - acceptable only when construction is cheap, idempotent and does not leak an unmanaged handle.
pitfalls: GetOrAdd may execute the valueFactory more than once for a racing first request (documented behaviour); the discarded value is never returned, but its side effects - opened connections, subscribed events, allocated handles - are not undone.
GetOrAdd guarantees the value that is returned, not that the instance is thread safe: shared mutable state inside the instance still needs its own synchronisation.
Nothing in ConcurrentDictionary evicts: with per-request keys the registry is an unbounded memory leak.

variants.name: ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, Lazy<T>> run-once slot
variants.implementation_notes: When construction is expensive or must run exactly once, store a Lazy<TInstance> per key: GetOrAdd(key, k => new Lazy<TInstance>(() => new TInstance(k))).Value. The dictionary may still build a discarded Lazy object, but Lazy.Value runs the factory exactly once under LazyThreadSafetyMode.ExecutionAndPublication, and threads that ask for the same key block until the first initialisation finishes - which is what the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline does with its per-type cache.
pitfalls: Lazy.Value blocks every thread that touches the same key until the first initialisation completes, so a slow or hanging connect stalls all callers of that key.
Lazy caches exceptions: if the factory throws, the same exception is rethrown on every later request for that key - build retry into the factory, or remove the slot.
The extra Lazy object per key is another allocation per registration; for trivial construction plain GetOrAdd is cheaper.
